customValue.label: Child Care Provider Information (license #, phone #, and care start date) NOTE: You must send this information to have your child care costs covered. This information does not impact your CCCAP eligibility.
Child Custody Arrangement. (This may be a court order or written agreement between the parents).
Complete, signed and dated application form (Signature is needed from the primary caretaker in the home).
Complete, signed and dated Redetermination Summary Form. (Signature is needed from the primary caretaker in the home).
Copy of the court order for the child support paid out. Note: income will not be adjusted if this verification is not received
Employment Termination Verification. (This must include last day physically at work, date of last pay check and gross amount of last pay check).

Employment Verification Letter. (This must include work schedule (if requesting care during the evening, overnight, or on a weekend), hourly wage or monthly gross salary, start date, and first check date).
Immunization Verification. (This can be a short record or statement from the doctor or nurse stating that your child is age-appropriately immunized).

Maternity or Paternity Leave/Temporary Leave of Absence Verification. (This must include date of leave, expected return, last pay check date, gross amount of last pay check, and whether leave is paid or not).
Paystubs received in the thirty (30) days prior to the date of this notice.
Residence Address Verification. (This could be a lease, utility bill, etc.).
Substance Use Disorder treatment program name and address (this can be self-declared to your caseworker verbally or in writing)
Verification of child support paid out for a child in another household. (This can be a statement from the custodial parent, cancelled checks, receipts, or copies of payments).
Verification of child's citizenship.
Verification of child's identity. (This may be a picture id for the primary adult caretaker).
Verification of the school/training activity. (This can be your class schedule or a statement from your advisor).
Verification of unearned income. (This can be stubs, award letters, etc.).
Verification of your self-employment expenses for the at least the most recent thirty (30) days. (This can be a ledger with receipts for expenses, etc.).
Verification of your self-employment income and hours worked for at least the most recent 30 days of income. (This includes ledgers, income receipts, owner's draws, online statements, etc.)
Verification of your work schedule. (This can be your posted schedule or a statement from your employer).
Verification of the job search activity.
Verification of your self-employment income and expenses. (This can be a ledger with receipts for expenses, tax documents, receipts for income and expenses, etc.).
